column3: While we rarely encounter survivors, we're always prepared for the occasion. You don't have to worry about food and shelter.
The isle's thawed enough that I could pitch a tent for you and your companions. It isn't much, but it should be comfortable enough.
If I may ask...what does Estinien do for a living? When not on watch, he's constantly training, and often without any upper garments despite the cold...
We're not far now! While the journey's taken longer than expected, having you all for company made it go by faster.
The isle has thawed up nicely as well. We should be able to hand it off as soon as we arrive.
